rule: Stereocentres that are not part of the reaction keep the handedness they have in the reactant.
name: chirality

rule: Atoms that are stereocentres in the product already have the product's handedness at the transition state.
name: product_stereo

rule: Atoms that are never bonded to each other, in the reactant or the product, are not squashed unrealistically close together.
name: clash

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Atoms never bonded in reactant or product are not closer than a fraction of their covalent-radius sum."""
    n = rxn.n
    if n < 2:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    rad = {1: 0.31, 6: 0.76, 7: 0.71, 8: 0.66}
    bonded = set(rxn.reactant_bonds) | set(rxn.product_bonds)
    r = np.array([rad.get(int(a), 0.75) for a in rxn.atoms])
    xyz = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float)
    d = np.linalg.norm(xyz[:, None, :] - xyz[None, :, :], axis=-1)
    iu, ju = np.triu_indices(n, 1)
    dist = d[iu, ju]
    rsum = r[iu] + r[ju]
    # hard floor for any non-bonded pair: 0.70 of covalent sum, at least 0.75 A
    limit = np.maximum(0.70 * rsum, 0.75)
    bad = np.where(dist < limit)[0]
    worst = None
    for k in bad:
        i, j = int(iu[k]), int(ju[k])
        if (i, j) in bonded:
            continue
        ratio = float(dist[k] / rsum[k])
        if worst is None or ratio < worst[0]:
            worst = (ratio, i, j, float(dist[k]))
    if worst is not None:
        _, i, j, dd = worst
        return False, f"non-bonded {rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} only {dd:.2f} A apart"
    return True, "no unbonded atom pair is unrealistically close"

rule: Bonds that survive the reaction keep a length close to their lengths in the reactant and product.
name: spectator_bonds

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Bonds present in both reactant and product keep lengths near their reactant/product values."""
    changed = set(tuple(sorted(b)) for b in rxn.changed_bonds)
    surv = [b for b in rxn.reactant_bonds if b in rxn.product_bonds and b not in changed]
    if not surv:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    rc = rxn.reaction_centre
    worst = None
    for (i, j) in surv:
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp)
        # bonds touching the reaction centre may stretch/shift more than spectator bonds
        tol = 0.35 if (i in rc or j in rc) else 0.2
        if d > hi + tol:
            dev = d - hi
        elif d < lo - tol:
            dev = lo - d
        else:
            continue
        if worst is None or dev > worst[0]:
            worst = (dev, i, j, d, dr, dp)
    if worst is not None:
        dev, i, j, d, dr, dp = worst
        return False, (f"bond {rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A "
                       f"(reactant {dr:.2f}, product {dp:.2f}, off by {dev:.2f} A)")
    return True, "surviving bonds stay close to reactant/product lengths"

rule: Bonds that form or break have lengths in between their reactant and product values.
name: reacting_bonds

attempts.code:
def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Each forming/breaking bond length lies between its reactant and product values (with tolerance)."""
    tol = 0.05
    checked = 0
    for (i, j) in rxn.changed_bonds:
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp)
        checked += 1
        if d < lo - tol or d > hi + tol:
            return False, (f"{rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A, "
                           f"outside [{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}] A (reactant {dr:.2f}, product {dp:.2f})")
    if checked == 0:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    return True, f"all {checked} changing bonds lie between reactant and product lengths"

def check(rxn, xyz):
    """Each forming/breaking bond length lies between its reactant and product values, allowing for TS overshoot."""
    checked = 0
    for (i, j) in rxn.changed_bonds:
        dr = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.reactant_xyz[i] - rxn.reactant_xyz[j]))
        dp = float(np.linalg.norm(rxn.product_xyz[i] - rxn.product_xyz[j]))
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(xyz[i] - xyz[j]))
        lo, hi = min(dr, dp), max(dr, dp)
        # real TSs often stretch a bond well past the longer endpoint value
        lo_lim = lo - 0.2
        hi_lim = hi + 0.5 + 0.35 * hi
        checked += 1
        if d < lo_lim or d > hi_lim:
            return False, (f"{rxn.symbols[i]}{i + 1}-{rxn.symbols[j]}{j + 1} is {d:.2f} A, "
                           f"outside [{lo_lim:.2f}, {hi_lim:.2f}] A "
                           f"(reactant {dr:.2f}, product {dp:.2f})")
    if checked == 0:
        return True, "rule not applicable"
    return True, f"all {checked} changing bonds lie within tolerance of the reactant-product range"

rule: Double bonds and aromatic rings that do not take part in the reaction stay flat.
name: planarity
